# Linkwell

Notes that link themselves. Local-first, Markdown files, free.

Linkwell watches a folder of Markdown notes and suggests links between them as you type, using a small embedding model that runs on your laptop. Nothing leaves your machine.

Built because I kept writing the same idea in three notes without noticing. In my own vault of 2,400 notes it found 310 links I had missed in the first week.

- Works on any folder of .md files, including an existing Obsidian vault
- macOS and Windows, 40 MB download
- Free and open source (MIT)

Download: github.com/example/linkwell/releases
